name: Nakajima (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nakajima village emblem in white: a stylised angular device of two mirrored characters, like a bow tie.
history: Municipal flag of Nakajima, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 June 1971.

features.role: Nakajima village emblem — a stylised angular device of two mirrored characters, like a bow tie
